name: URY desk launcher screen
describe: The /desk apps screen: the page navbar, then one .desktop-icon tile per add_to_apps_screen app (ERPNext, URY, Huf), each a 54px app-icon in .icon-container over .icon-caption with the title and the Open in Desk subtitle.
The subtitle is drawn for apps whose own UI is not the desk (URY and Huf); ERPNext is desk-native and has none. Frappe HR and Framework are not installed on this bench.
